events.title: Swiss SMI Closes 0.4% Higher After Mid-Day Volatility
events.description: Switzerland's benchmark SMI index gained 58.68 points to close at 14,597.63 after fluctuating between gains and losses throughout Tuesday's session. VAT Group led gainers with a 3.5% climb, while Galderma Group declined over 3%.

events.title: European Equities Rally On Tech Strength Amid Policy Watch
events.description: European stocks ended Tuesday higher on technology gains tied to artificial intelligence developments, including Nvidia's partnership with Meta. The Stoxx 600 advanced 0.5% as investors watched for upcoming central bank policy decisions.

events.title: U.S. Consumer Confidence Unexpectedly Sees Substantial Improvement In October
events.description: Consumer confidence in the U.S. has unexpectedly seen a substantial improvement in the month of October, according to a report released by the Conference Board on Tuesday. The Conference Board said its consumer confidence index jumped to 91.7 in October from an upwardly revised 84.2 in September.

events.title: U.S. New Home Sales Pull Back Much Less Than Expected In September
events.description: A report released by the Commerce Department on Tuesday showed a modest pullback in new home sales in the U.S. in the month of September. The Commerce Department said new home sales fell by 0.6 percent to an annual rate of 676,000 in September after surging by 5.1 percent to a revised rate of 680,000 in August.

events.title: Boeing Q3 Loss Narrows, Commercial Airplanes Revenues Drop; Shares Down
events.description: Aerospace and defense major Boeing Co. reported Tuesday that its third-quarter net loss narrowed sharply, while it recorded an operating profit, compared to prior year's loss, amid lower expenses and higher revenues. Commercial Airplanes revenue, meanwhile, dropped from last year, despite higher deliveries. In the morning trading on the NYSE, the shares were losing 3.64 percent.

events.title: U.S. Durable Goods Orders Jump 1.8% In September, More Than Expected
events.description: Largely reflecting a surge in orders for transportation equipment, the Commerce Department released a report on Tuesday showing new orders for U.S. manufactured durable goods shot up by more than expected in the month of September. The Commerce Department said durable goods orders jumped by 1.8 percent in September following a revised 0.1 percent uptick in August.

events.title: U.S. Durable Goods Orders Jump More Than Expected In September
events.description: Largely reflecting a surge in orders for transportation equipment, the Commerce Department released a report on Tuesday showing new orders for U.S. manufactured durable goods shot up by more than expected in the month of September.

events.title: Canadian Stocks Set For Mixed Open
events.description: Canadian equities are expected to open mixed on Tuesday as investors digest quarterly earnings and commodity market movements. Celestica reported third-quarter revenue of $5.83 bln and adjusted EPS of $3.30, up 83% and 109% respectively from a year ago.

events.title: Euro Falls Amid Risk-off Mood, ECB Policy Eyed
events.description: The euro weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Tuesday, amid risk-off mood by the investors as British banking giant HSBC posted disappointing earnings and French student leaders vowed to carry out further protests despite government concessions on education aimed at easing mounting unrest.

events.title: FTSE 100 Retreats On Earnings Misses, Shop Price Inflation Surge
events.description: The FTSE 100 declined 81.65 points to 10,685.68 following disappointing results from HSBC Holdings and Reckitt Benckiser. UK shop price inflation accelerated to 2.1% year-on-year in October, its highest in 2.5 years.

events.title: Euro Falls Against Majors
events.description: The euro weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Tuesday.

events.title: CAC 40 Modestly Higher As Stocks Pare Early Losses
events.description: French stocks recovered after a weak start on Tuesday with investors reacting to some corporate earnings updates and looking ahead to the monetary policy announcements from major central banks, including the Federal Reserve and the European Central Bank this week.

events.title: German Stocks Mixed As Fed, ECB Decisions Approach
events.description: Germany's benchmark DAX declined marginally Tuesday with mixed stock performance as major central banks prepare policy announcements. Beiersdorf shares fell 4.4% after third-quarter sales missed expectations, while Porsche gained 2% on strong profit.
